newsitem.title: FRANCE: Jospin to hold contacts with Euro counterparts.
newsitem.headline: Jospin to hold contacts with Euro counterparts.

text.p: French Prime Minister Lionel Jospin will be making contacts with his counterparts abroad, notably those in Europe, Olivier Schrameck, head of the prime minister's private office said on Thursday.
He declined to say whether any date had been fixed for a meeting with German Chancellor Helmut Kohl.
"I confirm that the prime minister will have contacts with his counterparts, notably his European counterparts," Schrameck told a news conference.

Government spokeswoman Catherine Trautmann declined comment when asked how Jospin planned to handle the European Union's so called stability pact, due to have been approved by heads of state at a summit in Amsterdam on June 16-17.
"The prime minister will speak both about his presence (in Amsterdam) and the...approach," she said.
She said Jospin would make decisions about his presence at international summits in consultation with President Jacques Chirac.
The Socialist party has said they want to renegotiate the stability pact.
European Affairs Pierre Moscovici told reporters, however, that the new Socialist-led government would obviously be looking at European issues.
"As you know, there are important European events next week."
